subject: Finance Innovators Summit — booth ledger & pipeline reconciliation
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FIS booth ledger — initial mismatch vs Fintegral claim

Team,

Quick recap from the Finance Innovators Summit (Nov 12–13) — Event ops sent the post-show report and Fintegral is claiming 18 MQLs from on-site demos that aren’t reflected in our pipeline rollup. We pulled a preliminary match (attached: FIS_leads_pipeline_match.csv) and see ~11 clearly matched opportunities; 7 are ambiguous due to email variations and UTM stripping on the registration form.

Key ask: can Sales and Field verify whether those 7 ambiguous contacts should be credited to Fintegral under the sponsorship MOP? We need the definitive mapping to close the loop with Procurement & the partner.

Notes:
- Attached CSV has our HubSpot contact IDs + event touchpoints.
- Field KPI rollup (coming) will show lead counts by channel.

Please reply with: 1) which of the 7 ambiguous leads you can confirm as Fintegral-sourced, 2) any additional proof (call notes/demo logs, event badge scans), and 3) whether we should accept the partner earnback at 50% of deal ACV or propose a different formula.

Timebox: I’d like a consolidated position by COB Mon (11/23) so we can respond to Fintegral Tuesday.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: FIS_leads_pipeline_match.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FIS booth ledger — initial mismatch vs Fintegral claim

Mina —

Thanks for the pull. I ran a quick hubspot export focusing on lifecycle stage and first touch. Two points worth flagging:

1) Our matching rule uses exact email + event-utms; because the on-site demo sign-up had manual entry we lose the utm_referrer in ~40% of records (that explains most of the ambiguity).
2) Of the 7 ambiguous, I can confirm 4 that have demo call notes referencing Fintegral (call recordings attached in CRM). The remaining 3 look like web-originated leads with later outreach at the booth — borderline.

Recommendation: mark the 4 confirmed as Fintegral-sourced in HubSpot, open a manual attribution case for the 3 borderline leads, and request badge scan logs from EventCo for proof-of-presence.

I attached a quick rollup (field_kpi_rollup_Q4.xlsx) with match flags.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Field Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: field_kpi_rollup_Q4.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegral.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@eventco.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Finance Innovators Summit — sponsorship lead credit

Mina,

Appreciate the quick look. From our side Fintegral documented 18 qualified demo leads from the booth (names + business emails attached on our end). Our SDRs followed up and converted 3 POCs into opportunities last week. We viewed the sponsorship as driving demo-qualified traffic; the ask is that those 18 be reflected in your attribution so standard earnback clauses apply.

I’m happy to share our lead list and meeting notes if that helps reconcile the remaining 7. We’d prefer a 100% credit on leads captured directly via our demo signups; if Redwood requires additional proof, we can provide the timestamped demo roster and the four short video clips where we collected the emails.

Can we get a definitive answer on credit by EOD Wed (11/25)? Our renewal committee is waiting on the reconciliation to finalize next quarter’s scope.

— Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Fintegral
liam.oconnor@fintegral.com | +44 20 7946 0912

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegral.com>, Priya Shah <priya@eventco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed reconciliation & conditional earnback formula (FIS)

Hi all —

Pulled everything together after Ben’s match and Liam’s note. Proposed next steps below:

1) Confirmed credit: Mark the 4 leads Ben validated as Fintegral-sourced in HubSpot today.
2) Borderline set (3 leads): run a quick presence check against EventCo badge logs (Priya, can you surface timestamped badge scans for those 3?). If EventCo confirms presence within the demo window, we grant credit.
3) Earnback proposal for the remaining dispute: if EventCo confirms presence but we lack a direct demo sign-in, award 50% credit on any opportunity ACV that closed within 90 days and can be shown to have Fintegral follow-up activity.
4) If Fintegral can provide timestamped demo roster entries and the 3 borderline leads match exactly, credit 100%.

I’ve created a shared folder and a reconciliation checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_FIS-recon — please upload evidence there. Once both sides confirm we’ll produce a short amendment (DocuSign) to the sponsorship MOP.

Timeline: evidence in folder by EOD Wed (11/25), reconciliation call Thu 11/26 10am PT (30 min).

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegral.com>, Priya Shah <priya@eventco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finance Innovators Summit — booth ledger & next steps

Liam / Priya —

Thanks both. Confirming the plan:

- Fintegral to upload their signed lead list + any timestamped demo roster clips to the shared Drive folder by EOD Wed (11/25).
- EventCo (Priya) to pull badge scan logs for the 3 borderline leads and drop in the folder.
- Redwood (Ben/Marissa) will mark the 4 confirmed leads and run a HubSpot export for the reconciliation call.
- If EventCo confirms presence: 50% conditional earnback kicks in unless Fintegral can provide exact timestamped sign-up matching, in which case we’d apply 100% credit.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu 11/26 10am PT and prepare the short amendment for signature post-call. Appreciate the fast turnaround — want to keep this tidy for renewal.

Talk soon — Mina
Mina Haddad
Sr. Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: signed_mop.pdf
